cds.title: Wellesley Common Data Set 2025-2026 (C8A test policy, C13 application fee)

test_policy.notes: Wellesley states it will continue to be test optional for applicants entering in fall 2027. The 2025-26 CDS (C8A) also lists SAT/ACT as not required but considered if submitted. NOTE: wellesley.edu returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so the live pages were read only through search-extracted text; recheck the page before relying on exact wording.

requirements.notes: Personal essay (250-650 words) plus a shorter Wellesley-specific writing supplement. Two teacher recommendations and the counselor School Report. Application fee: the 2025-26 CDS (C13) answers 'No' to having an application fee. Interview policy and CSS Profile requirement not confirmed. Wellesley is a women's college.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Decision mid-December (no exact date published); enrollment deposit due early January. Dates read via search-extracted page text (site blocks automated fetch); verify.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decision late March (no exact date published); reply by May 1. Date read via search-extracted page text; verify.

english_policy.waiver_notes: No English proficiency exam is required. Strongly recommended if English is not your native language and you have studied in an English-medium curriculum for fewer than four years. No minimum scores were published on the pages found.

english.notes: TOEFL iBT or TOEFL Essentials accepted; no minimum score found.
C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency or C1 Business Higher accepted; no minimum found.

aid.notes: Wellesley is need-blind only for U.S. citizens and permanent residents. For international citizens admission is need-aware and the College can fund only a limited number of awards, but admitted students receive their full calculated need. International applicants must request aid when applying (not accepted after the admission decision). Read via search-extracted page text (site blocks automated fetch); verify.
